<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

nltl:TRF-010-IceClassDesignationShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:class nltl:ship ;
    sh:closed false ;
    sh:description """TRF-010, Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof, section 1.8: ships are assigned to the six stated ice classes. This shape represents the designation record and controlled ice-class value. The source descriptions of structure, engine output, hull condition and navigational capability remain visible as source text; they are not independently reconstructed or inferred by this shape.""" ;
    sh:message "A ship in the caller-admitted synthetic ship population must have exactly one represented ice-class designation from the six source-defined values." ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    sh:property nltl:TRF-010-IceClassPropertyShape ;
    rdfs:seeAlso <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#iceClass> ;
    rdfs:comment """Applicability retained from section 1.1: the provisions in section 1.8 apply to all ships irrespective of year of build. External population eligibility and experimental source-edition selection are caller-attested research assumptions, not independently certified by this shape.""" ;
    rdfs:comment """Source edition: TRAFICOM/68863/03.04.01.00/2021, 2021 regulation issued 1 July 2021. Source file SHA-256: e0bf179c97a1535aa7d4d0dd5d4053edf5f3f4e7e028c49d14c3a31cc7c1e8ba. Selected section 1.8 offsets: 17575-22652; selection SHA-256: b2b5cfa500af3e02bdd7399cf29656dbc3dbb76605bb5aa2c8c290efd42fb1f9.""" ;
    rdfs:comment """The retained source manifest records an unresolved multiple-reference anchor for section 1.8 in the supplied retrieval context. The explicit selected section-1.8 evidence above is preserved; no additional applicability or edition rule is inferred from the unresolved reference.""" .

nltl:TRF-010-IceClassPropertyShape
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:path nltl:iceClass ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
    sh:in (
        nltl:iceClassIaSuper
        nltl:iceClassIa
        nltl:iceClassIb
        nltl:iceClassIc
        nltl:iceClassIi
        nltl:iceClassIii
    ) ;
    sh:message "iceClass must occur exactly once and its value must be one of IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II or III." ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    rdfs:comment """The source-defined value set is represented using the canonical ontology individuals. The RDFS domain of nltl:iceClass is a typing assertion and is not treated as an exclusive ownership rule.""" ;
    rdfs:comment """Source selection for section 1.8: file data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt; source SHA-256 e0bf179c97a1535aa7d4d0dd5d4053edf5f3f4e7e028c49d14c3a31cc7c1e8ba; start offset 17575; end offset 22652; selection SHA-256 b2b5cfa500af3e02bdd7399cf29656dbc3dbb76605bb5aa2c8c290efd42fb1f9.""" .

nltl:iceClassIaSuper
    a nltl:iceClassValue, skos:Concept ;
    skos:prefLabel "IA Super"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source section 1.8 paragraph 1: ships with such structure, engine output and other properties that they are normally capable of navigating in difficult ice conditions without the assistance of icebreakers." .

nltl:iceClassIa
    a nltl:iceClassValue, skos:Concept ;
    skos:prefLabel "IA"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source section 1.8 paragraph 2: ships with such structure, engine output and other properties that they are capable of navigating in difficult ice conditions, with the assistance of icebreakers when necessary." .

nltl:iceClassIb
    a nltl:iceClassValue, skos:Concept ;
    skos:prefLabel "IB"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source section 1.8 paragraph 3: ships with such structure, engine output and other properties that they are capable of navigating in moderate ice conditions, with the assistance of icebreakers when necessary." .

nltl:iceClassIc
    a nltl:iceClassValue, skos:Concept ;
    skos:prefLabel "IC"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source section 1.8 paragraph 4: ships with such structure, engine output and other properties that they are capable of navigating in light ice conditions, with the assistance of icebreakers when necessary." .

nltl:iceClassIi
    a nltl:iceClassValue, skos:Concept ;
    skos:prefLabel "II"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source section 1.8 paragraph 5: ships that have a steel hull, are structurally fit for navigation in the open sea and, despite not being strengthened for navigation in ice, are capable of navigating in very light ice conditions using their own propulsion machinery." .

nltl:iceClassIii
    a nltl:iceClassValue, skos:Concept ;
    skos:prefLabel "III"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Source section 1.8 paragraph 6: ships that do not belong to the ice classes referred to in paragraphs 1-5." .
<END_SHACL>
